name: agentic-processes-ui
description: Visual UI for the Agentic Processes Framework
author: Matan Hager

scripts.electron:build: npm run build:channel-server && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build:channel-server && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build:channel-server && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build:channel-server && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
scripts.release: npm run build:channel-server && vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
